rule.name: CanonicalNameMayBeNull
rule.message: Class.getCanonicalName() returns null for anonymous, local and hidden classes (lambdas) and for arrays of them, so using it as a map key, as a StringBuilder seed, as a call receiver or in a string that is used as a name throws a NullPointerException or yields "null" as soon as such a class arrives. Use getName() (or getTypeName() for arrays), or fall back to it: String name = type.getCanonicalName() != null ? type.getCanonicalName() : type.getName(). Class literals of named classes (Foo.class) never return null and are not reported, and neither are texts of exceptions, log calls and toString.
